# Meilenguru

> Meilenguru is a bilingual (German/English) site about earning airline miles
> and flying Business Class from Switzerland. It covers the Miles & More and
> Flying Blue loyalty programmes, Swiss credit cards (Amex, Cornèrcard,
> Swisscard), award redemption strategies, real trip reports, and a paid
> 30-minute personal consultation. Content is Swiss-specific: CHF pricing,
> Swiss card issuers, and departures from Zürich, Geneva and Basel.

Languages: German (primary, Swiss audience) and English, as full parallel
page pairs — every guide and article exists in both.

## Main pages

- https://meilenguru.ch/ — English homepage
- https://meilenguru.ch/index-de — German homepage
- https://meilenguru.ch/strategies — Earning-strategy hub (Miles & More, Flying Blue, Amex, benchmark comparison)
- https://meilenguru.ch/strategien — German strategy hub
- https://meilenguru.ch/beste-kreditkarte-meilen-schweiz — Best Swiss credit cards for earning miles (German)
- https://meilenguru.ch/meilenguru-strategy-best-swiss-credit-cards-miles — English twin
- https://meilenguru.ch/referrals — Referral codes for Swiss card welcome bonuses
- https://meilenguru.ch/empfehlungen — German twin
- https://meilenguru.ch/tools — Free miles calculator, destination map and lounge finder
- https://meilenguru.ch/tools-de — German twin
- https://meilenguru.ch/blog — Trip reports and strategy articles
- https://meilenguru.ch/blog-de — German twin
- https://meilenguru.ch/faq — Frequently asked questions
- https://meilenguru.ch/faq-de — German twin

- https://meilenguru.ch/ueber-mich — German twin
